title: SimplGUI
body:
# SimplGUI

Minecraft's GUI, now simple.

# What does this resource pack give?

This resource pack focuses mostly on minecraft's GUI and gives it a more simple look, less details, less than 2 colour on the detailed parts.

# Hold up!

This resource pack only currently supports 1.19.4, i do not know and haven't tested if it supports older versions.
If you do test it and it works with a version that isn't 1.19.4, please contact me.
